name: Yobot R2V2
summary: Yobot R2V2 is Openmind Robotics’ bipedal humanoid platform for physical work. It combines whole-body movement and manipulation with visual perception and the company’s robot software platform. An official demonstration showed R2V2 opening a carton, grasping water bottles and placing them on retail shelves. The model was introduced in the 2026 Yobot family; current ordering and delivery availability are unverified.
